description: This file defines a middleware class for AWS SDK's S3 client that injects the ObjectURL into the result of certain PutObject-related operations to make the URL readily accessible.

classes.name: PutObjectUrlMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that adds ObjectURL information to the result of S3 commands like PutObject, CopyObject, and CompleteMultipartUpload.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method that creates a middleware instance wrapping a given handler.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the middleware with the next handler.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, intercepts command results, and injects ObjectURL where applicable.
